verdict: Lead volume dropped sharply this week; ad creative is being refreshed now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 99 leads at an average cost of $7.46 per lead, but the most important signal this week is a 45% drop in leads over the last 7 days compared to the 7 days before it — on virtually flat spending. That pattern points to creative fatigue on Meta, the sole active paid channel, where the same ads have been running long enough to lose effectiveness. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to reverse the trend. In parallel, your pipeline shows 102 opportunities created with no booked appointments logged, which we are examining as an intake process question, not an ads issue. Expect lead volume to stabilize as the new creative rolls out; we will report its early results next week.
